conclusions.combination: AND/OR do not improve source-macro F1 over Laplacian; AND modestly improves verification event recall.
conclusions.gaussian: Both metrics are monotonic; Laplacian has stronger paired attenuation and better temporal F1 in this grid.
conclusions.limits: Engineering calibration only; no real blur labels, no cleaning threshold, no classification performance claim; FPS is confounded with source.
conclusions.motion: Both detect the tested line-kernel blur; Laplacian has higher temporal F1, not a universal real-motion result.
conclusions.retain_two: Retain both for diagnostics and sensitivity checks; Laplacian is the leading candidate for the next bounded study.
conclusions.third_metric: No new metric added: current metrics clearly respond to synthetic motion blur.
